detailZh: 为什么2026年巴林大奖赛要在马来西亚举行？
在马来西亚举办巴林大奖赛：一级方程式从未见过这样的场面。我们解释为什么这场比赛将在雪邦举行，以及为什么它仍将沿用巴林的名字
2026年巴林大奖赛将不在巴林举行，而是在马来西亚举行。赛事将于10月2日至4日在吉隆坡附近的雪邦国际赛道举行，正赛定于10月4日星期日。它的官方名称是“在马来西亚举行的F1海湾航空巴林大奖赛”。
更换举办地的原因是中东的战争。原定于4月举行的巴林站比赛不得不取消。通过在马来西亚举办一场替代赛事，巴林大奖赛得以保留在赛历之上。
巴林大奖赛原定于2026年4月10日至12日举行，是本赛季的第四站。沙特阿拉伯大奖赛原定于一周后举行。2026年3月14日，一级方程式与国际汽联宣布，这两场比赛将不会在4月举行。
这一决定是在涉及伊朗的战争背景下做出的，该战争于2月下旬爆发。伊朗的袭击击中了巴林境内的目标，包括距离赛道仅几公里的燃油设施。整个地区的空中交通也受到严格限制。在这种情况下，无法安全地举办比赛周末。
一级方程式主席兼首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利当时表示：“虽然这是一个艰难的决定，但考虑到当前中东局势，这不幸地是现阶段正确的决定。”
春季没有替补比赛。由于没有足够的准备时间将一场比赛移师欧洲，导致日本大奖赛与迈阿密大奖赛之间出现了五周的空档。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；亚历山大·阿尔本，威廉姆斯
寻找替代赛道的计划于七月开始成形。最初有消息称，马来西亚正在考虑于2026年举办一场比赛。2026年7月26日，一级方程式和国际汽联正式确认，一级方程式将在阔别九年后重返马来西亚。
赛历和物流是选择雪邦的主要原因。这场比赛位于9月26日的阿塞拜疆大奖赛和10月11日的新加坡大奖赛之间。雪邦与新加坡之间仅相距约320公里。这形成了一个三连赛，而车队无需进行大规模的物流绕行。
还有就是赛道本身。从1999年到2017年，雪邦一直是一级方程式赛历上的固定站点。这座场馆是为大奖赛而建，在举办一级方程式赛事方面已经拥有丰富的经验。评论员马丁·布伦德尔也赞扬了相关人员所展现出的灵活性。
“这项运动再次证明了它适应变化、寻找解决方案并成功交付的能力，为所有关注一级方程式的车迷创造了一个激动人心的时刻，”多梅尼卡利说。
国际汽联主席本·苏拉耶姆表示，重返雪邦赛道“证明了我们与马来西亚赛车运动协会的紧密关系、马来西亚政府的持续支持，以及我们这项运动中国际合作的力量。”
为什么这项比赛仍然叫巴林大奖赛？
尽管比赛在马来西亚举行，这项赛事仍然保留巴林大奖赛的名称。这是一级方程式、国际汽联以及巴林和马来西亚两国政府之间协议的结果。巴林仍然是大奖赛的名义主办国，而比赛本身在雪邦国际赛道举行。巴林的国家航空公司海湾航空仍然是冠名赞助商。
巴林还决定票价，并根据雪邦国际赛车场的说法，由巴林获得门票销售收入。对巴林来说，这意味着其大奖赛并没有完全从2026年赛历上消失。门票正通过巴林国际赛车场官网销售。海湾航空也将赶在比赛周末之前开通巴林与吉隆坡之间的直飞航班。
巴林国际赛车场首席执行官萨勒曼·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法亲王表示：“自从我们宣布在马来西亚举办巴林大奖赛以来，车迷和这项运动相关人士的反馈令人难以置信。车迷现在有机会确保自己成为这段独一无二的F1历史的一部分。”
在‘错误’国家举办的大奖赛：以前也发生过
大奖赛在名称所指的国家之外举办，在一级方程式中并非完全没有先例。不过在以往的案例中，出借国名给比赛的国家与实际承办比赛的国家在地理上要接近得多。
1982年瑞士大奖赛在法国第戎举行，因为瑞士在1955年勒芒惨剧之后禁止了场地赛车。
圣马力诺大奖赛于1981年至2006年在意大利的伊莫拉举行。而意大利本身已经在蒙扎拥有自己大奖赛。
1997年和1998年，纽博格林承办了卢森堡大奖赛。
最近一次在雪邦举行的F1比赛由马克斯·维斯塔潘于2017年夺冠。塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔保持着在该赛道最多F1胜利的纪录，共四次。其他令人难忘的时刻包括迈克尔·舒马赫在1999年腿伤康复后的复出，以及刘易斯·汉密尔顿在2016年的引擎故障，这使他在年度冠军争夺战中损失了宝贵的积分。
2026年的比赛将为56圈，总里程310.418公里。一些车队正在为一级方程式重返雪邦做大量准备。例如，梅赛德斯已经宣布为马来西亚站带来一次重大升级。
与此同时，赛季的结束仍存在不确定性。卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛也取决于中东局势的发展。多梅尼卡利已经说明了一级方程式需要在什么时候对赛季收官站做出决定。
关于在马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛的常见问题
比赛周末将于2026年10月2日至4日举行。比赛本身将于10月4日星期日进行。
2026年巴林大奖赛将在哪里举行？
在马来西亚吉隆坡附近的雪邦国际赛道举行。
为什么2026年一级方程式不在巴林比赛？
原定于四月举行的比赛因中东战争而取消。伊朗的袭击击中了巴林境内靠近赛道的多处目标。
为什么在马来西亚举办的这场比赛会被称为巴林大奖赛？
巴林仍然是这项赛事名义上的主办国，并从门票销售中获得收入。巴林的国家航空公司海湾航空仍然是冠名赞助商。
一级方程式上一次在马来西亚比赛是什么时候？
2017年。马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得了最近一届马来西亚大奖赛的冠军。
detailEn: Why is the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix taking place in Malaysia?
A Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia: Formula 1 has never seen anything quite like it. We explain why the race is taking place at Sepang and why it will still carry the Bahrain name

The 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix will not take place in Bahrain, but in Malaysia. The event will be held from 2-4 October at the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur, with the race scheduled for Sunday 4 October. Its official name is the "Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia".

The reason for the move is the war in the Middle East. The original Bahrain race in April had to be cancelled. By staging a replacement event in Malaysia, the Bahrain Grand Prix remains on the calendar.

The Bahrain Grand Prix was originally scheduled to take place on 10-12 April 2026 as the fourth round of the season. The Saudi Arabian Grand Prix was due to follow one week later. On 14 March 2026, Formula 1 and the FIA announced that both races would not take place in April.

The decision came against the backdrop of the war involving Iran, which had begun in late February. Iranian attacks hit targets in Bahrain, including fuel facilities only a few kilometres from the circuit. Air traffic across the region was also severely restricted. Under those circumstances, it was not possible to stage the race weekend safely.

"While this was a difficult decision to take, it is unfortunately the right one at this stage considering the current situation in the Middle East," Formula 1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali said at the time.
There were no replacement races in the spring. There was not enough preparation time to move an event to Europe, leaving a five-week gap between the Japanese and Miami Grands Prix.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Alexander Albon, Williams

Plans for a replacement began to take shape in July. It initially emerged that Malaysia was considering hosting a race in 2026. On 26 July 2026, Formula 1 and the FIA officially confirmed that Formula 1 would return to Malaysia after a nine-year absence.

The calendar and logistics were major reasons for choosing Sepang. The race sits between the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on 26 September and the Singapore Grand Prix on 11 October. Sepang and Singapore are only around 320 kilometres apart. That creates a triple-header without requiring the teams to make a major logistical detour.

Then there is the circuit itself. Sepang was a permanent fixture on the Formula 1 calendar from 1999 to 2017. The venue was built for grand prix racing and already has extensive experience of staging Formula 1 events. Pundit Martin Brundle also praised the flexibility shown by those involved.
"Once again, the sport has demonstrated its ability to adapt, find solutions, and deliver, creating an exciting moment for everyone who follows Formula 1," said Domenicali.

FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem said the return to Sepang was "testament to our close relationship with the Motorsports Association of Malaysia, the continued commitment of the Malaysian Government, and the strength of international cooperation within our sport."
Why is it still called the Bahrain Grand Prix?

Despite being held in Malaysia, the event remains the Bahrain Grand Prix. This is the result of an agreement between Formula 1, the FIA and the governments of Bahrain and Malaysia. Bahrain remains the nominal host of the grand prix, while the race itself takes place at the Sepang International Circuit. Bahrain's national airline Gulf Air remains the title sponsor.

Bahrain also determines ticket prices and, according to the Sepang International Circuit, receives the revenue from ticket sales. For Bahrain, this means its Grand Prix has not disappeared entirely from the 2026 calendar. Tickets are being sold through the Bahrain International Circuit website. Gulf Air is also launching direct flights between Bahrain and Kuala Lumpur in time for the race weekend.

"The feedback from fans and those involved in the sport since we announced The Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia has been incredible. Fans now have their opportunity to ensure they are part of this unique piece of F1 history," said Shaikh Salman bin Isa Al Khalifa, Chief Executive of the Bahrain International Circuit.
Grands Prix in the 'wrong' country: It has happened before

A grand prix being held outside the country whose name it carries is not entirely unprecedented in Formula 1. In previous cases, however, the country lending its name to the race and the country actually hosting it were much closer geographically.
The 1982 Swiss Grand Prix was held at Dijon in France because Switzerland had banned circuit racing following the 1955 Le Mans disaster.
The San Marino Grand Prix was held at Imola in Italy from 1981 to 2006. Italy already had its own Grand Prix at Monza.
In 1997 and 1998, the Nurburgring hosted the Luxembourg Grand Prix.

The most recent Formula 1 race at Sepang was won by Max Verstappen in 2017. Sebastian Vettel holds the record for the most F1 victories at the circuit with four. Other memorable moments include Michael Schumacher's comeback from a broken leg in 1999 and Lewis Hamilton's engine failure in 2016, which cost him valuable points in the championship battle.

The 2026 race will run for 56 laps and cover 310.418 kilometres. Some teams are preparing extensively for Formula 1's return to Sepang. Mercedes, for example, has announced a major upgrade for Malaysia.

The end of the season, meanwhile, remains uncertain. The races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi also depend on developments in the Middle East. Domenicali has already explained when Formula 1 will need to make a decision on the season finale.
Frequently asked questions about the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
The race weekend will take place from 2 to 4 October 2026. The race itself will be held on Sunday, 4 October.
Where will the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix take place?
At the Sepang International Circuit near Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia.
Why is Formula 1 not racing in Bahrain in 2026?
The race scheduled for April was cancelled because of the war in the Middle East. Iranian attacks hit targets in Bahrain close to the circuit.
Why is the race in Malaysia called the Bahrain Grand Prix?
Bahrain remains the nominal host of the event and receives the revenue from ticket sales. Bahrain's national airline Gulf Air remains the title sponsor.
When did Formula 1 last race in Malaysia?
In 2017. Max Verstappen won the most recent Malaysian Grand Prix.

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."
